claim_traces.claim_text: "mRNA COVID-19 vaccines alter or permanently change human DNA."
reasoning_steps: The claim that mRNA COVID-19 vaccines alter human DNA is biologically impossible and demonstrably false
Vaccine mRNA delivers instructions to cellular ribosomes located in the cytoplasm to produce the spike protein; it never enters the cell nucleus where genomic DNA is stored
Furthermore, human cells lack the reverse transcriptase enzymes necessary to convert RNA back into DNA, and mRNA degrades rapidly after translation
Major public health organizations and scientific consensus worldwide confirm that mRNA vaccines do not interact with or integrate into the human genome.

claim_traces.claim_text: "Napoleon Bonaparte was unusually short — around 5 feet 2 inches tall."
reasoning_steps: The claim that Napoleon Bonaparte was unusually short at around 5 feet 2 inches is a widespread historical misconception
Historical records, including his autopsy and memoirs by his physician and associates, recorded his height as approximately 5 feet 2 inches in pre-metric French units ("pieds de roi" and "pouces")
In standard English imperial units, this converts to roughly 5 feet 6 inches (approximately 1.67–1.68 meters)
During the early 19th century, the average height for an adult French male was about 5 feet 5 inches, meaning Napoleon was actually of average or slightly above-average height for his era

The persistent myth of his shortness arose from the unit conversion discrepancy, British wartime political caricatures (notably by James Gillray), and his affectionate nickname among soldiers, "le petit caporal."
